{{Quote|Captain, much as I enjoy conversing with you&mdash;even though the sight of your ugly face makes me bilious&mdash;I still have a daily administrative quota to meet. How can I help you? Be concise.|Losh to [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]]|<ref name="SS" />}}
'''Losh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SS" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Losh worked as a civil servant in [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]]&mdash;former bodyguard of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]&mdash;sought Losh's help in finding out how the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] died. Losh and Typho first traded insults as was proper in Jenet society before Losh decided to aid Typho. Despite the danger he was placing himself in, Losh allowed Typho to view a list of known Jedi and the manner of their deaths.<ref name="SS" />
